Bull.story: Agents and offline add GMV Shopify would not otherwise see: revenue about $47B (+25%/yr); merchant gross margin holds at 38% because agent checkouts carry the same fees; opex falls to 21.5% of revenue, so operating margin reaches about 23%; buybacks retire a net 1.5% of shares a year; 40× owner earnings.

Base.story: Share gain, payments attach and international carry revenue to about $42B (+22%/yr compound); agents are a channel, not a toll; gross margin drifts down on mix; opex falls to 24% of revenue, so operating margin reaches about 20%; buybacks just offset stock pay; 35× owner earnings.

Bear.story: Growth fades to about 15% a year (about $31B of revenue) as agents and Amazon take the discovery layer and a fee share; merchant gross margin falls to 35% and AI costs keep subscription margin falling; operating margin about 14%; 25× owner earnings.

optionality.name: Equity stakes (Affirm, Klaviyo, Global-E and others) at Sep 30 carrying value, $5.4B
